topography.project_purpose: Prediction Market. Structurally: 33 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 11 ERC20 tokens, 2 ERC1155 multi-tokens; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 2 functional families. Its contracts share 31 common project-authored base contract(s) (erc20basic, blacklistable, fiattokenv1_1). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
